_comment: Per-site PUE for the v9 topology (scripts/sweep/topologies/v9_real_pue.json), selected with PUE_TABLE=common/pue_by_dc_real.json. The shipped common/pue_by_dc.json (uniform 1.1) is untouched and remains the default.
_source: Operator-reported annual PUE. Azure: 2022 figures (Ireland 2021). Google: 2023 per-facility figures. AWS: 2023 figures (regional/country level). Where a location appears for more than one operator the most recent year is kept, and between Google and AWS (both 2023) the Google per-facility figure. 'facility' = an operator's site lies in that grid zone; 'state'/'country' = the value of a site elsewhere in the same state or country.
